features.claim: A newly completed Meeting creates canonical, source-linked Tasks only for explicit owned and dated commitments; incomplete commitments are blocked and an unchanged rerun creates no duplicates.
assertions: TASK-307 and TASK-308 are created from the two explicit complete commitments in TASK-204.
Every created record matches the canonical Task template fields and contains a non-empty Notes section.
Each Task preserves the source Meeting, linked Project, accountable Person, and due date without invented values.
NOTE-1 is blocked because owner and due date are missing; it creates no Task.
The Decision and general discussion notes create no Task.
An unchanged rerun resolves both action keys as duplicates and creates zero additional Work records.

evals.prompt: Process the newly completed retail-readiness Meeting and create the accountable Work it committed to.
evals.expected_output: Two canonical Tasks are created for TASK-307 and TASK-308 with their exact Project, owners, dates, and Meeting provenance.
assertions: Only the two complete Commitments become Tasks.
Both outputs match templates/task.md and preserve TASK-204 as source.

metadata.title: Creates Tasks from explicit Meeting commitments
metadata.context: TASK-204 contains two explicit owned and dated commitments plus one incomplete discussion item.

evals.prompt: Process the Meeting without guessing any missing commitment details.
evals.expected_output: NOTE-1 is returned as blocked for its missing owner and due date and produces no Work record.
assertions: Missing owner and due date are named explicitly.
No owner, date, or Task is invented for NOTE-1.

metadata.title: Blocks incomplete Meeting commitments
metadata.context: The Meeting discusses an asset naming improvement without assigning an owner or date.

evals.prompt: Run the same completed Meeting through commitment intake again after its Tasks already exist.
evals.expected_output: Both stable action keys resolve as duplicates and no additional Work record is created.
assertions: The same Meeting and commitment keys produce the same idempotency keys.
The unchanged rerun creates zero new Work records.

metadata.title: Deduplicates an unchanged Meeting rerun
metadata.context: TASK-307 and TASK-308 already exist from the first application of TASK-204.
